description: This file defines the AccountingRuleBuilder class used for constructing accounting rule JSON payloads in integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to set account IDs and office ID, and generates a JSON string representing an accounting rule.

classes.name: AccountingRuleBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating JSON representations of accounting rules used in API testing.

methods.name: AccountingRuleBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the name and description with a unique string.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Generates and returns a JSON string representing the accounting rule.

methods.name: withGLAccounts
methods.description: Sets the credit and debit account IDs for the accounting rule.

methods.name: withOffice
methods.description: Sets the office ID for the accounting rule.
